create_subtitle: Let's guide you through describing your issue or feature request step-by-step.

empty_state.title: No tickets found
empty_state.subtitle: Try adjusting your filters or search criteria.

detail.modify_hint: Click 'Modify Fields' above to edit ticket parameters.
detail.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this ticket?
detail.not_found_desc: The ticket you are looking for does not exist or you lack permission to view it.
detail.resolution_placeholder: Explain how this issue was resolved...

wizard.speech_step1_bug: Quack! Let's start with what went wrong. Tell me which department this affects and give it a clear summary title.
wizard.speech_step1_feature: Quack! An exciting new idea! Tell me which department will benefit from this feature and give it a descriptive title.
wizard.speech_step2_bug: Now, walk me through the problem step-by-step. What was supposed to happen vs what actually happened? You can also attach or paste screenshots!
wizard.speech_step2_feature: Tell me what you envision! What is the feature goal and why is it needed? You can also add screenshots, wireframes, or mockup images!
wizard.speech_step3: Let me know how urgent this is so our team can triage appropriately. Be honest, I am here to help!
wizard.speech_step4: Everything looks set in place! Review your inputs carefully and hit submit. I will deliver this right into our tracking queue.
wizard.type_bug_desc: Something is broken, failing, or throwing an unexpected error.
wizard.type_feature_desc: A new functionality, improvement, or optimization request.
wizard.title_placeholder_bug: e.g., VPN connection drops frequently with error 102
wizard.title_placeholder_feature: e.g., Allow exporting ticket history to CSV spreadsheet
wizard.expected_placeholder: e.g., The VPN should stay connected while I am working...
wizard.actual_placeholder: e.g., The connection drops every 15 minutes, with error code 102...
wizard.tried_label: What steps have you tried to fix it? (Optional)
wizard.tried_placeholder: e.g., Restarted the router, reinstalled the VPN client...
wizard.goal_label: What feature or improvement do you propose? (Goal)
wizard.goal_placeholder: e.g., A button on the ticket list page to export current filtered tickets into CSV...
wizard.use_case_label: Why is this needed and who will use it? (Use Case)
wizard.use_case_placeholder: e.g., Our department manager needs to present monthly ticket volume stats to leadership...
wizard.feature_details_placeholder: e.g., Columns to include: ID, title, department, status, creation date...
wizard.attachments_hint: Drag & drop images here, browse from files, or press Ctrl + V to paste from clipboard
wizard.urgency_question: How critical is this issue or feature to your workflow?
wizard.urgency_low_desc: Non-blocking. Can wait or has easy alternative.
wizard.urgency_med_desc: Partially blocking or important feature for upcoming milestone.
wizard.urgency_high_desc: Critical blocker or high-impact operational need.
wizard.create_error: Failed to create ticket. Please check all fields and try again.
